description: An older woman in a dark green blouse and a rust-and-cream shawl looks down at a small dark object held between her fingers, with a bangled wrist visible. Behind her a line of women in saris stands under a large banyan tree with hanging aerial roots, and a brick village building with a doorway and a small pale paper notice sits to the right. Painterly, warm, dappled light, filling the frame edge to edge.
